w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Callback is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: ◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 1,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 24 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."

📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Lottery. Pure luck. Draw a token. The audience loves an underdog."

loss.line: Haven couldn't hold. On the fifth hungry day, people started walking — in different directions. The scattering, again.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high — the shelves are nearly bare.
